diff --git a/test/units/executor/test_forked_display.py b/test/units/executor/test_forked_display.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..01f9d2e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/units/executor/test_forked_display.py
@@ -0,0 +1,110 @@
+import importlib
+import multiprocessing
+import queue
+import threading
+import time
+
+import pytest
+
+def _send_from_worker(final_q):
+    Display = importlib.import_module('ansible.utils.display').Display
+    display = Display()
+    display.set_queue(final_q)
+    display.display(u'worker message', color='blue', stderr=True, screen_only=True, log_only=False, newline=False)
+
+
+def _send_late_from_worker(final_q):
+    time.sleep(0.1)
+    final_q.send_display(u'late worker output')
+
+
+def test_parent_cannot_set_display_queue():
+    Display = importlib.import_module('ansible.utils.display').Display
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
+        Display().set_queue(None)
+
+
+def test_forked_display_preserves_call_without_writing_in_worker(capsys):
+    FinalQueue = importlib.import_module('ansible.executor.task_queue_manager').FinalQueue
+    final_q = FinalQueue()
+    worker = multiprocessing.get_context('fork').Process(target=_send_from_worker, args=(final_q,))
+    try:
+        worker.start()
+        event = final_q.get(timeout=5)
+        worker.join(timeout=5)
+        assert worker.exitcode == 0
+        assert event.args == (u'worker message',)
+        assert event.kwargs == dict(color='blue', stderr=True, screen_only=True, log_only=False, newline=False)
+        assert capsys.readouterr() == ('', '')
+    finally:
+        if worker.is_alive():
+            worker.terminate()
+            worker.join()
+        final_q.close()
+
+
+def test_results_thread_replays_all_display_events(capsys):
+    DisplaySend = importlib.import_module('ansible.executor.task_queue_manager').DisplaySend
+    strategy_module = importlib.import_module('ansible.plugins.strategy')
+
+    final_q = queue.Queue()
+    final_q.put(DisplaySend(u'first'))
+    final_q.put(DisplaySend(u'second', stderr=True, newline=False))
+    final_q.put(strategy_module.StrategySentinel())
+
+    class Strategy:
+        _final_q = final_q
+
+    strategy_module.results_thread_main(Strategy())
+    assert capsys.readouterr() == ('first\n', 'second')
+
+
+def test_parent_display_waits_for_its_lock(capsys):
+    Display = importlib.import_module('ansible.utils.display').Display
+    display = Display()
+    started = threading.Event()
+    finished = threading.Event()
+
+    def emit():
+        started.set()
+        display.display(u'locked')
+        finished.set()
+
+    with display._lock:
+        thread = threading.Thread(target=emit)
+        thread.start()
+        assert started.wait(2)
+        assert not finished.wait(0.05)
+    thread.join(timeout=2)
+    assert finished.is_set()
+    assert capsys.readouterr().out == 'locked\n'
+
+
+def test_strategy_cleanup_drains_worker_display_before_stopping_results(capsys, monkeypatch):
+    task_queue_module = importlib.import_module('ansible.executor.task_queue_manager')
+    strategy_module = importlib.import_module('ansible.plugins.strategy')
+    monkeypatch.setattr(task_queue_module.C, 'WORKER_SHUTDOWN_POLL_COUNT', 3)
+    final_q = task_queue_module.FinalQueue()
+    worker = multiprocessing.get_context('fork').Process(target=_send_late_from_worker, args=(final_q,))
+    tqm = task_queue_module.TaskQueueManager.__new__(task_queue_module.TaskQueueManager)
+    tqm._workers = [worker]
+
+    class Strategy:
+        _active_connections = {}
+        _final_q = final_q
+        _tqm = tqm
+
+    strategy = Strategy()
+    strategy._results_thread = threading.Thread(target=strategy_module.results_thread_main, args=(strategy,))
+    try:
+        strategy._results_thread.start()
+        worker.start()
+        strategy_module.StrategyBase.cleanup(strategy)
+        worker.join(timeout=5)
+        assert worker.exitcode == 0
+        assert capsys.readouterr().out == 'late worker output\n'
+    finally:
+        if worker.is_alive():
+            worker.terminate()
+            worker.join()
+        final_q.close()

diff --git a/test/units/executor/test_forked_display.py b/test/units/executor/test_forked_display.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..01f9d2e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/units/executor/test_forked_display.py
@@ -0,0 +1,110 @@
+import importlib
+import multiprocessing
+import queue
+import threading
+import time
+
+import pytest
+
+def _send_from_worker(final_q):
+    Display = importlib.import_module('ansible.utils.display').Display
+    display = Display()
+    display.set_queue(final_q)
+    display.display(u'worker message', color='blue', stderr=True, screen_only=True, log_only=False, newline=False)
+
+
+def _send_late_from_worker(final_q):
+    time.sleep(0.1)
+    final_q.send_display(u'late worker output')
+
+
+def test_parent_cannot_set_display_queue():
+    Display = importlib.import_module('ansible.utils.display').Display
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
+        Display().set_queue(None)
+
+
+def test_forked_display_preserves_call_without_writing_in_worker(capsys):
+    FinalQueue = importlib.import_module('ansible.executor.task_queue_manager').FinalQueue
+    final_q = FinalQueue()
+    worker = multiprocessing.get_context('fork').Process(target=_send_from_worker, args=(final_q,))
+    try:
+        worker.start()
+        event = final_q.get(timeout=5)
+        worker.join(timeout=5)
+        assert worker.exitcode == 0
+        assert event.args == (u'worker message',)
+        assert event.kwargs == dict(color='blue', stderr=True, screen_only=True, log_only=False, newline=False)
+        assert capsys.readouterr() == ('', '')
+    finally:
+        if worker.is_alive():
+            worker.terminate()
+            worker.join()
+        final_q.close()
+
+
+def test_results_thread_replays_all_display_events(capsys):
+    DisplaySend = importlib.import_module('ansible.executor.task_queue_manager').DisplaySend
+    strategy_module = importlib.import_module('ansible.plugins.strategy')
+
+    final_q = queue.Queue()
+    final_q.put(DisplaySend(u'first'))
+    final_q.put(DisplaySend(u'second', stderr=True, newline=False))
+    final_q.put(strategy_module.StrategySentinel())
+
+    class Strategy:
+        _final_q = final_q
+
+    strategy_module.results_thread_main(Strategy())
+    assert capsys.readouterr() == ('first\n', 'second')
+
+
+def test_parent_display_waits_for_its_lock(capsys):
+    Display = importlib.import_module('ansible.utils.display').Display
+    display = Display()
+    started = threading.Event()
+    finished = threading.Event()
+
+    def emit():
+        started.set()
+        display.display(u'locked')
+        finished.set()
+
+    with display._lock:
+        thread = threading.Thread(target=emit)
+        thread.start()
+        assert started.wait(2)
+        assert not finished.wait(0.05)
+    thread.join(timeout=2)
+    assert finished.is_set()
+    assert capsys.readouterr().out == 'locked\n'
+
+
+def test_strategy_cleanup_drains_worker_display_before_stopping_results(capsys, monkeypatch):
+    task_queue_module = importlib.import_module('ansible.executor.task_queue_manager')
+    strategy_module = importlib.import_module('ansible.plugins.strategy')
+    monkeypatch.setattr(task_queue_module.C, 'WORKER_SHUTDOWN_POLL_COUNT', 3)
+    final_q = task_queue_module.FinalQueue()
+    worker = multiprocessing.get_context('fork').Process(target=_send_late_from_worker, args=(final_q,))
+    tqm = task_queue_module.TaskQueueManager.__new__(task_queue_module.TaskQueueManager)
+    tqm._workers = [worker]
+
+    class Strategy:
+        _active_connections = {}
+        _final_q = final_q
+        _tqm = tqm
+
+    strategy = Strategy()
+    strategy._results_thread = threading.Thread(target=strategy_module.results_thread_main, args=(strategy,))
+    try:
+        strategy._results_thread.start()
+        worker.start()
+        strategy_module.StrategyBase.cleanup(strategy)
+        worker.join(timeout=5)
+        assert worker.exitcode == 0
+        assert capsys.readouterr().out == 'late worker output\n'
+    finally:
+        if worker.is_alive():
+            worker.terminate()
+            worker.join()
+        final_q.close()
